#Read in files
```{r}
MDUMetadata <- read_excel("../../MDU_Metadata/MDUMetadata.xlsx",sheet = 'Cleaned')
DHTraveldata <- read_excel("../../MDU_Metadata/DHTravelData.xlsx")
ShortReadGenomics <-read.csv("../NextflowResults/ShortReadCollatedNextflowResults.csv")
LongReadGenomics <- read.csv("../NextflowResults/LongAssemblyCollatedNextflowResults.csv")
SNPdists <- read.csv("../NextflowResults/GubbinsRcomMasked-SNPdists.tab",sep='\t',header = FALSE)
rfbLocusDepth <- read.csv("../NextflowResults/rfbLocusSeqDepth.csv")
NNDSS_state <- read_excel("../../NNDSS/Notifications Received By Jurisdiction.xlsx",skip = 2)
NNDSS_sex <- read_excel("../../NNDSS/Notifications By Age Groups and Sex.xlsx",skip = 2)

raxmlTree <- read.tree('../raxml/GubbinsRecombMasked.aln.raxml.bestTreeCollapsed')


#give snp dists col names
colnames(SNPdists) <- c("Sample1","Sample2","SNPdistance")
#remove snippyOut
SNPdists %<>%
  mutate(
    Sample1 = gsub("_snippyOut","",Sample1),
    Sample2 = gsub("_snippyOut","",Sample2)
  )

#add in patient ID columns to SNPdists
SNPdists %<>%
  left_join(
    select(MDUMetadata,SampleID,patient_id,collection_date),by=join_by(Sample1==SampleID)
  ) %>%
  rename(Sample1_patientID = patient_id,Sample1_collection_date = collection_date) %>%
  left_join(
    select(MDUMetadata,SampleID,patient_id,collection_date),by=join_by(Sample2==SampleID)
  ) %>%
  rename(Sample2_patientID = patient_id,Sample2_collection_date = collection_date) %>%
  mutate(
    SamePatient = case_when(
      Sample1_patientID == Sample2_patientID ~ T,
      T ~ F
    ),
    DaysBetweenSamples = abs(difftime(ymd(Sample1_collection_date), ymd(Sample2_collection_date), units='days'))
  )

#Merge MDU metadata and DH travel data
AllMetadata <- MDUMetadata %>%
  select(-ReportedTravel,-ReportedTravelCountry) %>%
  left_join(DHTraveldata,by='SampleID')

#merge short read genomics and MDU metadata
SRGenomicsPlusMeta <- AllMetadata %>% left_join(ShortReadGenomics,by='SampleID')

#fix tree tip labels
raxmlTree$tip.label <- unlist(lapply(raxmlTree$tip.label,strsplit,split='_snippyOut'))

MDRPlasmidBaktaTsv <- read.csv("../MDRPlasmidBakta/AUSMDU00127576_MDRplasmid_bakta.tsv",sep='\t',skip = 5)

#total number of travllers from ABS
TravelData <- read.csv("../ABS,OAD_COUNTRY,1.0.0+all.csv")
```

```{r}
filelist <- Sys.glob("../plasmid/pGY1andpGY2_blastresults/*.blasthits")
filelist_nonempty <- filelist[which(file.info(filelist)$size>0)]

results <- lapply(filelist_nonempty,read.csv,header=F,sep='\t')
names(results) <- unlist(lapply(filelist_nonempty,gsub,pattern='../plasmid/pGY1andpGY2_blastresults/',replacement=''))
mergedResults <- imap_dfr(results, ~ mutate(.x, id = .y))
colnames(mergedResults) <- c("QueryID","SubjectID","QueryLen","SubjectLen","Length","Pident","Qcov","QcovHSP","SampleID")
mergedResults %<>%
  mutate(
    SampleID = gsub(".blasthits","",SampleID)
  )
```

#total number of travellers

from ABSTotalTravellersByState 15635930 travellers returning to Vic

```{r}
totalTravelData <- TravelData %>%
  mutate(
    TimePeriodFixed = ym(TIME_PERIOD)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    CAT_TRAVELLER == 5, #returning travellers
    TimePeriodFixed >= "2018-07-01", 
    TimePeriodFixed < "2025-10-01",
    !(COUNTRY_RESID %in% c(paste("TO",1:9,sep=""),"TOT")) #remove totals
    ) %>% 
  group_by(Country.of.Stay.Residence) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = sum(OBS_VALUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    NormToTotal = (Total / 56417890), #taken from total row in df
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ProjectToVic = NormToTotal * 15635930
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(ProjectToVic))
totalTravelData
```

Merge across total travellers and normalise

```{r}
SRGenomicsPlusMeta %>%
  filter(InclusionExclusion == 'included', UniquePatients == T, InfectionSource == 'Travel') %>%
  count(CountryOfTravel,RegionOfTravel,sort = T) %>%
  left_join(totalTravelData,by = join_by(CountryOfTravel==Country.of.Stay.Residence)) %>%
  mutate(
    Incidence = (n / ProjectToVic) * 100000 #per 100,000 travellers
  )
```

# ITS test

```{r}
borderclose_q <- as.Date("2020-04-01") # quarter containing closure
borderreopen_q <- as.Date("2022-01-01") # quarter containing reopening

its_df <- reportedCases %>%
  arrange(Quarter) %>%
  mutate(
    t   = row_number(),
    qtr = factor(quarter(Quarter)),
    phase = case_when(
      Quarter < borderclose_q ~ "pre",
      Quarter == borderclose_q ~ "transition1",
      Quarter < borderreopen_q ~ "closed",
      Quarter == borderreopen_q ~ "transition2",
      TRUE ~ "post"
      ),
    phase = factor(phase, levels = c("pre", "transition1", "closed", "transition2", "post"))
  )

#exclude transition quarters
its_filt_df <- its_df %>% filter(!phase %in% c("transition1", "transition2")) %>%
  mutate(phase = droplevels(phase))
its_filt_df
```

```{r}
glm_pois <- glm(NNDSS_notifications ~ phase + t + qtr, family = poisson, data = its_filt_df)
summary(glm_pois)
# Dispersion check: should be close to 1
sum(residuals(glm_pois, type = "pearson")^2) / glm_pois$df.residual
```

From results above:
Everything is compared to phase-pre border closures
Significance means difference can be detected, non-significance just means difference not detected / not able to be detected
Rate ratios (i.e. percentage change) can be calculated from exp(Estimate) - test is in log space
The quarters are all compared to t0 (q1)

the dispersion (sum residuals) should be close to 1, 1.22 is ok ish


Rate ratios can be calculated with the below for the different phases
```{r}
glm_rr <- glm(NNDSS_notifications ~ phase + t + qtr, family = poisson, data = its_filt_df)
emmeans(glm_rr, ~ phase) %>%
  contrast(list("closed vs pre" = c(-1, 1, 0), "post vs pre" = c(-1, 0, 1)),
           type = "response", infer = TRUE)
```

For comparing year quarters and getting CI's
```{r}
emmeans(glm_pois, ~ qtr, type = "response") %>%
  contrast(method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = 1, infer = TRUE)
```

Check autocorrelation
Values shouldn't exceed blue lines, except for t0
```{r}
#Check autocorrelation
acf(residuals(glm_pois, type = "pearson"))
```

Autocorrelation looks ok

# Fisher's tests for associations between genotypes and QRDR mutations - needs cleaning

```{r}
SRGenomicsPlusMeta %>%
  filter(InclusionExclusion == 'included', UniquePatients == T) %>%
  count(ParaType_Genotype, Quinolone, sort=T)
```

```{r}
fisher_test <- SRGenomicsPlusMeta %>%
  filter(
    InclusionExclusion == 'included', 
    UniquePatients == T, 
    ParaType_Genotype %in% c( #only keep genotypes with more than 5 isolates
      '2.4.2',
      '2.3.3',
      '2.3.4',
      '2.4.1',
      '2.3.2',
      '2.3.1',
      '2.4',
      '2.4.3',
      '2.4.5'
      ))
#get presence of S83Y mutation
fisher_test$gyrAS83Y <- grepl("gyrA_S83Y", fisher_test[["Quinolone"]], fixed = TRUE)
```

run test on 2.3.4
```{r}
test <- table(fisher_test[["ParaType_Genotype"]] == "2.3.4", df$gyrAS83Y)
test
fisher.test(test)
```

run test on 2.4.5
```{r}
test <- table(fisher_test[["ParaType_Genotype"]] == "2.3.4", df$gyrAS83Y)
test
fisher.test(test)
```

```{r}
plot.AMR.time <- SRGenomicsPlusMeta %>%
  filter(
    InclusionExclusion == 'included',
    UniquePatients == TRUE
    ) %>%
  mutate(
    Quarter = floor_date(ymd(received_date),unit = 'quarter') + days(45), #swap to received date as collection date is sometimes empty
    Quinolone = case_when(
    Quinolone == "" ~ "None",
    T ~ Quinolone
  )) %>%
  group_by(Quarter,Quinolone) %>%
```

# rfb locus

## locus depth
depth is raw depth for each sample
NormDepth is depth divided by mean depth across entire genome


```{r}
rfbLocusDepth %>%
  mutate(
    GeneName = case_when(
      pos >= 860000 & pos <= 867000 ~ 'LeaderChrom',
      pos >= 867698 & pos <= 868538 ~ 'rfbS',
      #pos >= 869620 & pos <= 870919 ~ 'rfbX',
      #pos >= 870920 & pos <= 871922 ~ 'rfbV',
      #pos >= 872496 & pos <= 873558 ~ 'rfbU',
      pos >= 870332 & pos <= 873216 ~ 'Repeat',
      #pos >= 870332 & pos <= 870919 ~ 'rfbXCterChunk',
      #pos >= 872496 & pos <= 873216 ~ 'rfbUNterChunk',
      T ~ 'temp_intergenic'
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(GeneName) %>%
  summarise(
    AvgNormDepth = mean(NormDepth)
  )
```


```{r}
#depth normalised to entire genome depth, averaged per genotype
rfbLocusDepth %>%
  left_join(SRGenomicsPlusMeta,by='SampleID') %>%
  group_by(pos,ParaType_Genotype) %>%
  summarise(MeanNormDepth = mean(NormDepth),.groups = 'drop') %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=pos,y=MeanNormDepth)) +
  # annotate('rect',xmin = 867698, xmax = 868538,ymin = -Inf, ymax=Inf,alpha=0.25)+ #rfbS  
  # annotate('rect',xmin = 869620, xmax = 870919,ymin = -Inf, ymax=Inf,alpha=0.25)+ #rfbX
  # annotate('rect',xmin = 870920, xmax = 871922,ymin = -Inf, ymax=Inf,alpha=0.25)+ #rfbV
  # annotate('rect',xmin = 872496, xmax = 873558,ymin = -Inf, ymax=Inf,alpha=0.25)+ #rfbU
  geom_vline(xintercept = 867698,color='blue4') +
  annotate('rect',xmin = 870332, xmax = 873216,ymin = -Inf, ymax=Inf,alpha=0.25)+
  geom_line() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x="Genome Position in AKU_12601",
    y="Average Normalised Sequencing Depth Per Basepair"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90,vjust=0.5)) +
  facet_wrap(~ParaType_Genotype)
```

mean Chrom Norm depth can just be plotted as is

raw depth needs to be normalised to rfbS


```{r}
RepeatOverS <- rfbLocusDepth %>%
  mutate(
    GeneName = case_when(
      pos >= 867698 & pos <= 868538 ~ 'rfbS',
      pos >= 870332 & pos <= 873216 ~ 'Repeat'
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(SampleID,GeneName) %>%
  summarise(
    meanRawdepth = mean(depth,na.rm=T), #average raw depth over loci
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = GeneName,values_from = meanRawdepth) %>%
  mutate(
    RepeatOverS = Repeat / rfbS,
  ) %>%
  group_by(SampleID) %>%
  summarise(
    RepeatS = mean(RepeatOverS),.groups = 'drop'
  )

RepeatChromNorm <- rfbLocusDepth %>%
  mutate(
    GeneName = case_when(
      pos >= 870332 & pos <= 873216 ~ 'RepeatChromNorm'
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(SampleID,GeneName) %>%
  summarise(
    meanChromNormdepth = mean(NormDepth,na.rm=T), #average Normalised depth
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = GeneName,values_from = meanChromNormdepth) %>%
  select(SampleID,RepeatChromNorm)

LongReadGenomes <- SRGenomicsPlusMeta %>%
  filter(!is.na(DMG_ID)) %>%
  pull(SampleID)

plot.rfbDepthNorm <- SRGenomicsPlusMeta %>%
  left_join(RepeatOverS,by = 'SampleID') %>%
  left_join(RepeatChromNorm,by='SampleID') %>%
  filter(SampleID %in% includedSampleIDs) %>%
  select(SampleID,RepeatS,RepeatChromNorm,ParaType_Genotype) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(RepeatS,RepeatChromNorm),names_to = "Normalization.Target",values_to = "NormalisedDepth") %>%
  filter(!(is.infinite(NormalisedDepth))) %>% #remove one sample were rfbS is missing
  mutate(
    ClosedGenomes = case_when(
      SampleID %in% c("AUSMDU00093461",LongReadGenomes) ~ 'Closed',
      T ~ 'other'
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y=NormalisedDepth,x=ParaType_Genotype,color=ClosedGenomes,size = ClosedGenomes,shape=ClosedGenomes)) +
  geom_beeswarm(na.rm = T,fast = F) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Closed" = 'red3', 'other'='black')) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c("Closed" = 2.5,'other' = 1)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Closed" = 17,'other' = 19)) +
  guides(size='none',shape='none',color='none') +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_markdown(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45,hjust=1)
    ) +
  labs(
    x="Paratype Genotype",
    y="Average Normalized Sequencing Depth\nOver 2.8kbp Repeat"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Normalization.Target,ncol=2,labeller=as_labeller(c(RepeatChromNorm = "Normalized to Full Genome",RepeatS="Normalized to *rfbS*")))

plot.rfbDepthNorm
```

```{r}
p <- gggenomes(genes = rfb_genes2,seqs = rfb_seqs_reorder,links = rfb_paf,infer_bin_id = Genotype) +
  geom_seq() + 
  scale_x_bp(suffix = "bp") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_markdown(),
    legend.position = 'right',
    legend.box = 'horizontal',
    ) +
  geom_link(aes(fill=Identity),alpha=0.5,inherit.aes = F) + 
  scale_fill_continuous(
    name="Nucleotide Identity",
    palette = c("#EFEDF5", "#BCBDDC", "#756BB1"),
    guide = guide_colorbar(order = 1)
    )+
  new_scale_fill() +
  geom_gene(aes(fill=GeneFill),inherit.aes = F,size=4) + 
  scale_fill_manual(name="Gene Label",
  values = c(
    "rfb Locus" = '#a1d99b',
    "Paratype Surveyed Gene" = '#006d2c',
    "rfbX" = "#08519c",
    "rfbU" = "#a50f15",
    "SPA rfbV" = "#dd3497",
    #"Glycosyltransferase" = "#b2df8a",
    "RfbU::X 435aa" = "#54278f",
    "RfbU::X 247aa" = "#807dba",
    "RfbU::X 210aa" = "#bcbddc",
    "RfbU\u0394194-353ter" = "#ef3b2c",
    "RfbU\u03941206-353ter" = "#fc9272",
    "Other Gene" = 'grey'
  ),
  breaks = c(
    "rfb Locus",
    "Paratype Surveyed Gene",
    "rfbX",
    "rfbU",
    "SPA rfbV",
    #"Glycosyltransferase",
    "RfbU::X 435aa",
    "RfbU::X 247aa",
    "RfbU::X 210aa",
    "RfbU\u0394194-353ter",
    "RfbU\u03941206-353ter",
    "Other Gene"
  ),
  labels = c(
    "*rfb* Locus",
    "Paratype Surveyed Gene",
    "*rfbX* (Paratype Surveyed)",
    "*rfbU*",
    "SPA *rfbV*",
    #"Glycosyltransferase",
    "RfbU::X 435aa",
    "RfbU::X 247aa",
    "RfbU::X 210aa",
    "RfbU\u0394<sup>194-353ter</sup>",
    "RfbU\u0394<sup>206-353ter</sup>",
    "Other Gene"
  ),
  guide = guide_legend(order=2)
  ) +
  #labs(title = "Genotype") +
  geom_bin_label(size = 4) #+
  #geom_gene_note(aes(label = gene))
```


```{r}
filelist <- Sys.glob("../plasmid/DMG2401232_EF088686_plasmid_blastresults/*.blasthits")
filelist_nonempty <- filelist[which(file.info(filelist)$size>0)]
```

```{r}
#cols  qseqid sseqid qlen slen length pident qcovs qcovhsp
results <- lapply(filelist_nonempty,read.csv,header=F,sep='\t')
names(results) <- unlist(lapply(filelist_nonempty,gsub,pattern='../plasmid/DMG2401232_EF088686_plasmid_blastresults/',replacement=''))
mergedResults <- imap_dfr(results, ~ mutate(.x, id = .y))
colnames(mergedResults) <- c("QueryID","SubjectID","QueryLen","SubjectLen","Length","Pident","Qcov","QcovHSP","SampleID")
mergedResults %<>%
  mutate(
    SampleID = gsub(".blasthits","",SampleID)
  )
```

```{r}
sampleids <- mergedResults %>%
  filter(Length > 2346) %>%
  count(SampleID) %>%
  pull(SampleID)

length(sampleids)
```
